units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:14">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>יום פ׳ של פרעה וכ׳</he> it was Pharaoh’s day of reception of ambassadors &c.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 <cite ref="Q01650"><he>פרוזבטיא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Megillah 15a">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>זה בא בפרוזבולי וזה בא בפ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בפרוס בולי בפרוס ביטי …</he>) the one (Haman) had come to court as a member of the boulé (senate, πρὸς βουλῇ), and the other (Mordecai) as one of the legates (to plead for the building of the Temple); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1045:2">Yalk. Esth. 1045</cite> <he>ומשם ירדי פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>ירד פרוזבי׳</he>) and from there they (Mordecai and Haman) went down (to Shushan) as legates &c.; <he>אמרו ישראל … לפיכך יֵרֵד פְרוּזְבּוּטָן כנגדו</he> (not <cite ref="Q01642"><he>פרוזבוטו</he></cite>) the Israelites said, Mordecai is …, therefore let him go as our legate against him (Haman); Yalk. Am. 545 <cite ref="Q01633"><he>פרווטי׳</he></cite> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="Q01644">next art.</cite>
